```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-sec-primitives
#| fig-cap: "Verification primitives: integrity and channel costs"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

names = ['seal\n(legacy 2-way)', 'seal\n(pattern 4-way)', 'verify\n(pattern)', 'refresh\n(pattern)',
         'sign', 'verify', 'exchange', 'verify\nreceipt']
costs = [138.8, 171.4, 129.2, 296.0, 117.6, 86.1, 132.7, 86.8]
colors = ['white', '#888888', '#cccccc', '#eeeeee', '#aaaaaa', '#dddddd', '#999999', '#dddddd']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.0))
ax.bar(range(len(names)), costs, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
for i, c in enumerate(costs):
    ax.text(i, c + 6, f'{c:.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(names)))
ax.set_xticklabels(names, fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('Cost per operation (ns)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0, 360)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)

ax.axvspan(-0.5, 3.5, color='black', alpha=0.04)
ax.axvspan(3.5, 7.5, color='black', alpha=0.06)
ax.text(1.5, 344, 'integrity', ha='center', fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic')
ax.text(5.5, 344, 'channel', ha='center', fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic')

ax.annotate('epoch binding\n+33 ns', xy=(1, 171.4), xytext=(1.5, 250), fontsize=7,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8))
ax.annotate('verify =\nrecompute', xy=(2, 129.2), xytext=(2.85, 95), fontsize=7,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8))
ax.annotate('refresh =\nverify + seal', xy=(3, 296.0), xytext=(4.8, 255), fontsize=7,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8))

fig.tight_layout()
```
